additional_info.subject: RE: ID0397568-DC/Si-D/AE-[MP / R8 170002421] Outlets OOO CRM:00579001370
additional_info.body:
Hello Basheer,
Greetings of the day!
We checked the error flags and found that-
We need to check the breaker QA1 and its connections onsite.
Refer the below KA:
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SID_HW_Braeker,QA1_Mainbreaker QA1 error -
Attached images for your reference. Kindly check the connections according to it.
Check contactors QA28-QA29 and trace its path till MA1 according to image. Also check LED of pin DQ9 and DQ10 on KF2.
Check for aux contact (NO-terminal 1&4 ) of QA1 (it should work as per the MCCB change over).
Please trace the connections till (DI12 pin on KF5) according to the image.
Do let us know if you have any queries. We will wait for your feedback.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
